entry.title: BIP 110: update status to closed
entry.summary:
The historical incident involving CoiledCoin highlights significant vulnerabilities in the cryptocurrency industry, particularly concerning the power dynamics of mining. CoiledCoin was an altcoin that supported OP_EVAL but faced severe disruptions due to Luke using his mining pool to create empty blocks, which only contained coinbase transactions. This action escalated the difficulty levels to such extremes that it effectively barred the community from further mining once he ceased his activities. This aggressive strategy led to the demise of CoiledCoin, evidenced by Luke's own declaration on a forum post ([see the original discussion](https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=56675.msg676981msg676981)), where he nonchalantly announced the closure of what he referred to as "LukeCoin."
The narrative extends beyond this specific event to broader implications regarding Bitcoin Improvement Proposals (BIPs) and their perceived endorsement by the community. There is a misconception that the inclusion of a BIP signifies community support or acceptance, which is not necessarily the case. This misunderstanding also applies to testnets; some believe that their inclusion in Bitcoin Core adds value to them, mirroring the misinterpretations surrounding BIPs. The political nature of decisions about what gets included in Bitcoin Core or recognized as a BIP has grown, overshadowing more technical or utilitarian considerations. This evolution reflects a shift where Bitcoin Core is seen not just as a collection of technical specifications and updates but as a brand, with the inclusion in it perceived as an endorsement of value and legitimacy.
In summary, these incidents and perceptions demonstrate the complex interplay of technology, politics, and community dynamics within the cryptocurrency ecosystem. They underscore the need for clearer understanding and communication about what technological adoptions and endorsements by core platforms genuinely mean and the impact they have on the broader landscape.
